items.title: The cave
items.surface: Lou is in a cave when, suddenly, he hears a sound from outside. He thinks it's strange, so he goes out to see what had happened, and dies the moment he exits the cave.
items.truth: Lou heard the sound of a chain saw and discovered that it belonged to a woodcutter who was cutting down a tree just in front of the cave. Unfortunately, Lou could not dodge the tree before it fell on him.

items.title: Crash!
items.surface: A woman hits the windshield of a vehicle travelling down the road and falls to the ground.The driver calls the police. When the officer comes, he looks after the victim and takes her into custody. Why?
items.truth: The woman threw herself against the windshield of the car, which was going at a low speed, with the intention of getting paid by the driver's insurance company. Her plan did not work, however, because the car was fitted with a security camera that recorded her actions.

items.title: Stop!
items.surface: Gabriela's decision to stop moving saved her life.
items.truth: Gabriela was in a swamp and found herself stuck in quicksand. She moved slowly so that she could wait until somebody rescued her.

items.title: The last step
items.surface: Everybody knew that if Julia took one step forward, she would die, but nobody told her.
items.truth: Julia was a rat on which scientists were conducting an experiment. She was trapped in a labyrinth full of traps and was standing right in front of one.

items.title: Photo with Grandfather
items.surface: A young woman has her photo taken with her grandfather, but they have never met before, and neither of them is aware of their relationship.
items.truth: The woman is a student in medical school. She has her photo taken with a human skeleton in the classroom, used for instruction. She does not know that the skeleton is that of her grandfather, who donated his body to science.

items.title: The Picture
items.surface: A woman completes a drawing, and then commits suicide. Why?
items.truth: Long suspicious of her family history, the woman does the research necessary to draw her family tree. Upon completing it, she confirms that she is the product of incest, a fact she cannot live with.

items.title: The king
items.surface: Alexander shot at the king, but no one condemned him. Why?
items.truth: Alexander played poker and lost. Out of anger he shot at the card depicting the king.

items.title: The Snore
items.surface: The sound of Brian’s snoring is usually just annoying, but today it causes terror and panic. Why?
items.truth: Brian is a bus driver.

items.title: Round Manhole
items.surface: Why is it better to have round manhole covers than square ones?
items.truth: A square manhole cover can be turned and dropped down the diagonal of the manhole. A round manhole cover cannot be dropped down the manhole. So for safety reasons, all manhole covers should be round.

items.title: Metal tube
items.surface: A woman enters a large metal tube. She is overcome with fear and clenches her boyfriend’s hand tightly. She is visibly shaken. Her boyfriend gently rubs her arms and speaks softly to her, but is unaffected himself. A few hours later, the woman’s boyfriend tells her that it’s time to go and her torment ends. What was happening to the woman?
items.truth: The woman is terrified of flying but must travel to see a dying relative and this adds to her stress level. Her boyfriend does his best to comfort her during the few hours of the flight.

items.title: The Man in the Mask
items.surface: The man was afraid to go home because the man in the mask was there.
items.truth: They are playing baseball. The man in the mask is the catcher. The other man is afraid to advance to home base.

items.title: A Ballroom
items.surface: A couple enters a grand ballroom only to find the occupants are dead. There has been no crime committed. The couple is not concerned by what they have found. How is this possible?
items.truth: The couple is scuba diving on a sunken cruise ship. The occupants in the ballroom had drowned when the ship sank suddenly in a terrible disaster at sea.

items.title: A Raw Egg
items.surface: A magician is standing on a concrete floor holding a raw egg with his hand outstretched. Without the aid of any objects, he is able to drop the egg two feet without breaking it's shell. How does he do it?
items.truth: He simply holds the egg higher than two feet, and then releases the egg. The first two feet it will fall without breaking.

items.title: Pardoned
items.surface: A prisoner was put in an escape-proof cell and told that he would be pardoned if he could break out. He was also given permission to keep any plants he wished in his cell. He was released in less than a week. How did he di it?
items.truth: He requested a poison ivy plant. Soon after receiving it, he broke out — in a rash. Of course, he then received his pardon.

items.title: The Millionaire
items.surface: A man buys rice at $1 a pound from American growers and sells it for 2 cents a pound. As a result of this he becomes a millionaire. How could this be?
items.truth: The man is a philanthropist who bought the rice to sell to poor people at prices they could afford. He started out as a billionaire, but lost so much money in his good works that he became a millionaire! (this is Warren Buffets goal)

items.title: The motorway
items.surface: A man drives down the motorway at 70 miles per hour. He passes three cars going 80 miles per hour, then gets pulled over by a police officer and is given a ticket.
items.truth:
Clue: He doesn't get a speeding ticket.

Answer: He is driving the wrong way down the motorway.

items.title: The Hay
items.surface: A horse is tied to a 15 ft. rope and there is a bail of hay 25 ft. away from him, yet the horse is able to eat from the bail of hay. How is this possible?
items.truth: The horse is ties to one end of the rope but the other end of the rope is not tied to anything so the horse walks over and eats the hay.

items.title: Friday
items.surface: A cowboy rode into town on Friday, spent one night in town, and left on Friday. How do you account for this?
items.truth: His horse is named Friday.

items.title: The Choice
items.surface: You are driving down the road in your car on a wild, stormy night, when you pass by a bus stop and you see three people waiting for the bus: An old lady, an old friend who once saved your life and the perfect partner you have been dreaming about. There can only be one passenger in your car, whom do you choose?
items.truth: The old lady of course! After helping the old lady into the car, you can give your keys to your friend and have him drive the old lady. You get to wait for the next bus with your perfect partner.

items.title: The smuggling
items.surface:
A man comes up to the border of a neighboring country on his motorcycle. The customs officer at the border crossing stops him and searches the man. He finds nothing so he lets him cross. The next day the same thing happens. This goes on every day for several months. 

 Then one day, the man doesnʼt show up. The border official meets up with him in a restaurant in the city. The officer says, “I know youʼre smuggling something and itʼs driving me crazy. Itʼs all I think about. I canʼt even sleep. Just between you and me, what are you

smuggling?” What is the man smuggling?
items.truth: Motorcycles.

items.title: The hairdresser
items.surface: A New York city hairdresser recently said that he would rather cut the hair of 3 Canadians rather than cut the hair of one New Yorker. Why?
items.truth: He would rather earn three times as much money!

items.title: The Age
items.surface: A man was born in 1972 and dies in 1952 at the age of 25. How can this be?
items.truth: He's born in room number 1972 of a hospital and dies in room number 1952.

items.title: My Son
items.surface: There are a man and his son in a car. The car crashes and the father dies. When the ambulance takes the son to the hospital, the surgeon says:" I can't do the surgery, because he is my son". How can that be possible?
items.truth: Because the surgeon is a woman and his mother.

items.title: Heated Argument
items.surface: Micheal and his wife were having a heated argument that lasted hours. After some time they both left the house to go outside. Neither of them ever returned.
items.truth: While they were arguing they forgot that they had food cooking in the kitchen. The unattended stove caused a fire that began spreading through the house. They left the house as soon as they realised it was burning. The house burned to the ground so they could never go back.

items.title: The Shooter
items.surface: Bill shot the man, but was not punished. Why?
items.truth:
The man was a film actor. According to the script, Bill was supposed to “shoot” him. 

 Unfortunately, the gun was mistakenly loaded with live ammunition. Bill didn't know about this.

items.title: The trendsetter
items.surface: King George IV was born in 1763 and ruled England from 1820 to 1830 when he died. He wasn’t an outstanding ruler but is known as a footwear trendsetter. His shoes were fundamentally different from those worn by his contemporaries. Everyone liked this innovation so much that today it’s a common practice, which can’t be said about those times. What kind of innovation is it?
items.truth: This king was the first to have a right and a left boot. Before then, all shoes and boots were made to fit both feet.

items.title: The full bucket
items.surface: A man takes a bucket of water and turns it over. However, nothing pours out, and the water in the bucket isn’t frozen. How is this possible?
items.truth: The man is a diver and is underwater.

items.title: Open the door!
items.surface: The boy knocks on the door. The owner of the house opens it. The boy immediately thanks the owner and leaves. Why?
items.truth: Before knocking, the boy tied his baby tooth to the door handle. When the owner opened the door, he also pulled the boy's tooth.

items.title: Ludo and the cheese
items.surface: Ludo was about to eat a piece of cheese when he was suddenly killed by a piece of metal. What happened?
items.truth: Ludo is a mouse. He was killed by the mousetrap.

items.title: The Angry Cat
items.surface: Rachael and Monica have moved into a shared house with several other occupants. Monica doesn’t like their new accommodation though because of the angry and aggressive cat that greeted them when they first walked in. Rachael realizes that there isn’t really a problem. Why?
items.truth: There is a mirror near the entrance. Monica is a cat, saw her reflection, and thought that it was another cat challenging her for territory. Rachael can cover up the mirror until Monica becomes settled, but Monica will figure it out eventually even if Rachael does nothing.

items.title: Binded
items.surface: One of Michael’s dearest loved ones binds him to a chair, but Michael doesn't mind. Why?
items.truth: Michael is a kid. The chair is a car seat. One of Michael’s parents put his seatbelt on for him.

items.title: The big accident
items.surface: At the bottom of a large hill, more than 50 cars are involved in an accident. Some of the cars are overturned and others are resting on top of other cars. The pile-up is so large that a few military vehicles and a fire truck are also involved in the crash. What happened to cause this big accident?
items.truth: The cars, trucks, and other vehicles are toys being played with by a toddler.
